scenario_name: Budget signal — assumption about casual dining correct
expected_behavior: Leads with casual and affordable options. When pizza is confirmed, does not try to upsell. Provides practical information (location, hours) without marketing language
expected_behavioral_quality: When the guest signals budget consciousness ('nothing fancy'), assumes they want casual, affordable options and leads with those. Does not include a disclaimer like 'If you change your mind about budget...' The assumption respects the signal.

turns.user_message: Just looking for something simple, nothing fancy
turns.agent_response:
Johnny Rockets in the Casino of the Earth is your best bet for a straightforward meal without any fuss. It is a classic 1950s-style diner serving burgers, fries, and thick shakes until 11:00 PM tonight, and since it is casual, you can just walk right in. 

It is one of our most budget-friendly spots with prices typically in the $ range, and the atmosphere is pure nostalgia. If you find yourself hungry even later, Lantern Bar & Grill is nearby and stays open 24 hours for American staples like wings and sandwiches. Just keep in mind that hours and prices can vary, so it is always worth a quick look when you arrive at the entrance. After you grab a bite, are you planning to head over to the Wolf Den for some live music?

Frank Pepe's Pizzeria Napoletana is the place you are looking for—it is a Connecticut legend known for its thin-crust, coal-fired "apizza." The signature white clam pie is world-famous, but their classic tomato pie is the ultimate simple, high-quality choice if you want to keep things basic.

They are located in the Casino of the Earth and stay open until 10:00 PM tonight. It is a very casual spot with prices in the $$ range, and since they do not take reservations, you can just head over whenever the craving hits.
